text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Following a nice day out, Symboli Rudolf and I return to the academy…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Forgive me for asking, but are you busy right now?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I hoped we might speak a little longer. Over coffee, perhaps?
choice_data_list: Should we head over to my office?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That sounds perfect. Lead the—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Prez! There you are! I've been looking all over for you!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I pulled off the craziest win yesterday! I've gotta tell you all about it!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Dear me. No rest for the wicked, it seems…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove and Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: President! Hey, Prez!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I apologize for springing this on you so suddenly, but the student council has received a request from the director—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oh, no, you don't! We've got a situation over at the dorms, and I need the Prez's help pronto!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I can handle that myself later. The director's request is far more urgent—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hey, back off, you two! I had her first!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: You just want a chance to brag! This is urgent!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All of a sudden, a fight seems about to break out over Symboli Rudolf's attention.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hmmm, what to do?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It doesn't seem meant to be today, does it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But today will be far from our only chance.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now, you three, please settle down and wait your turn. I'll hear you all out in a more appropriate location.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The others quickly fall in line as Symboli Rudolf takes charge.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Goodbye, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'll see you tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As Symboli Rudolf walks away with the rest of the group in tow, it's hard not to admire the respect she commands from her peers.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No, there's no need. This is all just part of the job of student council president.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Besides, today will be far from our only chance to speak more. We'll just have to have our coffee together some other time.
